name: 78229 · San Antonio, TX
findings: ZIP 78229 (San Antonio) has 121 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78229 (San Antonio) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 11 professional organizations here list membership, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.
